name: medicaid_spending_by_state
description: What one state (or the nation) spent on Medicaid in a federal fiscal year, by service category, split into federal and state share. Source: CMS, Medicaid Financial Management Report (CMS-64 net expenditures), fiscal years 2014 onward. Returns the headline total net expenditures with the federal share percentage, then the service-category rows (inpatient hospital, nursing facility, prescribed drugs, managed care, and so on) largest first. Use `category` to filter by a word in the category name (e.g. "drug", "nursing", "managed care"). A state, fiscal year or category that matches nothing returns the valid values, not an empty list.

state.description: State, territory or DC: full name or two-letter code ("Texas", "TX"). "national" for the all-states total.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (October-September). Default: the latest in the series.

program.description: medical_assistance = benefit spending (default); administration = administrative costs.

category.description: Case-insensitive word or phrase to match in the service-category name, e.g. "drug", "nursing facility", "mco".

include_chip.description: Include the "C-" and "T-" CHIP-funded rows (default false).

name: medicaid_spending_trend
description: One state's Medicaid spending across federal fiscal years 2014 onward: total computable, federal share, state share and the effective federal share percentage per year, plus year-over-year growth. Defaults to the headline "Total Net Expenditures"; pass `category` to trend one service line (e.g. "Prescribed Drugs"). Source: CMS, Medicaid Financial Management Report (CMS-64).

state.description: State, territory or DC (name or code), or "national".

category.description: Exact or partial service-category name. Default "Total Net Expenditures". If several categories match, the exact one wins, otherwise the matches are listed.

name: medicaid_spending_ranking
description: States ranked by Medicaid spending in a federal fiscal year (total computable, federal share, state share, effective federal share percentage), largest first. Source: CMS, Medicaid Financial Management Report (CMS-64 net expenditures). Pass `category` to rank on one service line instead of the headline total.

category.description: Service-category name to rank on. Default "Total Net Expenditures".

name: medicaid_fmap
description: Federal Medical Assistance Percentage (the federal share of a state's Medicaid costs) and the enhanced FMAP for CHIP, by state and federal fiscal year 2014 through 2027. Source: HHS, annual Federal Medical Assistance Percentages notice in the Federal Register. Give a state for its rate history, a fiscal year for every state that year, or both for one rate. Standard rates only: temporary pandemic or disaster increases, the expansion-adult 90 percent rate and territory-specific program rates are not in this table.

state.description: State, territory or DC (name or code). Omit for all jurisdictions.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year, 2014-2027. Omit for all years (with a state) or the latest (without).

name: medicaid_expansion_spending
description: Quarterly Medicaid spending on the ACA expansion ("new adult" / VIII) group by state, with total computable and federal share, newly eligible versus not newly eligible, next to the state's all-medical-assistance total. Source: CMS, Medicaid CMS-64 New Adult Group Expenditures. Newest quarter first. "N/A" in the source (state had not expanded) is returned as null.

state.description: State name or code. Omit with a quarter to list every state for that quarter.

quarter_end.description: Quarter end date YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2025-06-30). Omit for recent quarters.

name: medicaid_increased_fmap_spending
description: Quarterly Medicaid expenditure under the temporary increased federal match periods, by state: the 6.2 point pandemic increase (Families First Act, 2020 onward) or the phase-down under the Consolidated Appropriations Act 2023. Returns all-medical-assistance total computable and federal share beside the share attributable to the increase. Source: CMS, Medicaid CMS-64 increased-FMAP expenditure reports.

program.description: ffcra = pandemic increase (2020-2023 quarters); caa2023 = phase-down (2023-2024 quarters). Default ffcra.

state.description: State name or code. Omit to list all states for a quarter.
